paragraphs: On Thursday, Mia's mom came to Teacher Kim's class. She is a doctor, and she works at the hospital in town. "Today I will show you how to take care of a cut finger," she said. Mia sat in the front with a proud smile. Mia's mom put a large box on the table. It had a bandage, a bottle of water, and some soap. The children were very quiet, and they listened to every word.

"First, wash your hands with soap," she said. "Then clean the cut with water." "Be careful, and do not touch the cut." She held up a fat paper finger with a red line on it. "Now put the bandage on the finger," she said. Leo walked to the table. He wrapped the bandage around the paper finger. "Not too tight, Leo," said Mia's mom. "Good! That is right." The class clapped for Leo.

"Does anyone have a question?" asked Mia's mom. Leo put up his hand. "What do I do when I have a toothache?" he asked. "Tell an adult at once," she said. "Open your mouth and show the adult your tooth." "Do not eat sweet food, and go to the dentist." May wrote the instructions in her notebook. Lily listened and looked at the big box.

At the end, Teacher Kim thanked Mia's mom. "Now you know what to do," said Mia's mom. "But please remember, a cut or a toothache is not funny." "A doctor is always ready to help." Mia gave her mom a big hug. The children walked out of the room, and all of them knew the steps.
